# Introduction

## Overview

- Dataset: World Development Indicators (World Bank, 2022)
- 217 countries
- 14 development indicators

# GDP per capita vs Life Expectancy

```{python}
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

df = pd.read_csv("wdi.csv")

plt.figure(figsize=(8,6))
plt.scatter(df["gdp_per_capita"], df["life_expectancy"])

plt.xlabel("GDP per capita")
plt.ylabel("Life expectancy")

plt.show()
```

## Top 10 Countries by GDP per Capita
```{python}
top10 = df.sort_values("gdp_per_capita", ascending=False).head(10)

plt.figure(figsize=(10,6))
plt.bar(top10["country"], top10["gdp_per_capita"])

plt.xlabel("Country")
plt.ylabel("GDP per capita")

plt.xticks(rotation=45)

plt.show()
```

## Conclusion
- GDP per capita varies significantly across countries
- Higher GDP per capita is associated with higher life expectancy
